name: Dreaded Wunder
detailed_description:
Dreaded Wunder is a first-person psychological horror game based in a twisted take of the historic city of Norwich that features a couple of local myths and legends that are themselves more monstrous that the tales would make them. The only tool you have to aid you in your survival is that of a modern mobile phone that acts as a looking glass into the twisted world that awaits you. 

Navigate this hellscape, search for Marks of Death to unlock the path forward and whatever you do keep all senses on high alert for the creatures now hunting you on their terms. 


Who Are You?

Step into the chilling world of Dreaded Wunder, where you play as Ash. An intrepid explorer who often finds themselves in places they shouldn't be. After a series of local disappearances and an eerie feeling of dread falling over Norwich, something from Ash's past has resurfaced and following the mark it left on ash is now seeking them out.

What Are They?

The myths and legends you were told are real and they are far more terrifying than the old tales claim. These creatures will hunt you and manipulate the very world around you. They have many names but most refer to them as omens of death, often appearing at times of great tragedy or to those who's time is up. 

 

How Do You Survive?

The Phone

Using Ash's phone, you can see the unseen whether it wants you to or not. Camera aside, your phone has many functions that could help. Take a picture, it maybe your last.

Marks of Death

Similar to the mark left on Ash, the twisted world has things that cant be seen directly. Finding them, capturing them will give you a chance to escape and get closer to freedom. 

Evade the Omens

Like a fly caught in a web, you aren't alone. Stay quiet, lay low and keep your wits about you. You'll have to play smart to escape your captors and undo the web that binds you.

Just don't rely on the Wi-Fi...

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bits)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 4800H @ 3.5 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1650 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
